treatment_summary: The patient with stage 5 CKD (eGFR 10) and recent NSTEMI is continued on guideline‑recommended secondary‑prevention agents (aspirin, prasugrel, high‑intensity atorvastatin, ACE‑I, beta‑blocker). To achieve the CKD‑specific BP target (<130/80 mmHg) amlodipine 5 mg daily is added, with titration as needed. Furosemide 20 mg daily addresses volume overload. CKD‑MBD is managed with calcitriol and sevelamer; ESA and sodium bicarbonate are planned pending laboratory confirmation of anaemia and metabolic acidosis. Opioid use is high; a structured taper is recommended, substituting acetaminophen where possible. All additions respect contraindications (no NSAIDs, no metformin, no ACE‑I + ARB) and potential interactions are flagged for monitoring. Ongoing labs (K⁺, Ca, PO₄, PTH, Hb, iron studies, LFTs) and clinical assessments (BP, weight, edema, LVEF) are required to safely titrate therapy per NICE NG107, NG136 and NG106.
